# Universal Animation Library 2

The runtime animation file `UAL2_Standard.glb` is provided by Quaternius and is
licensed under CC0 1.0 Universal. The source package is kept in
`game/Universal Animation Library 2[Standard]`.

- Creator: Quaternius (`@Quaternius`)
- License: [CC0 1.0 Universal](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)
- Source package: [Universal Animation Library 2](https://quaternius.com/)

The game uses the non-root-motion GLB and retargets its combat and movement
clips to the hero rig at runtime.
